gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma; Adult Gliosarcoma; Neoplasms, Brain; Neoplasms, Germ Cell and Embryonal; Recurrent Glioblastoma
Patients diagnosed with recurrent glioblastoma based on medical imaging after receiving standard therapy for glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase I trial evaluating the maximum tolerated dose, safety and efficiency of Mesenchymal stem cells into which the suicide gene, cytosine deaminase (CD), injected into the resection cavity of patients with recurrent glioblastoma.

candidate_flag.reason: Flucytosine is the prodrug of a cell/gene-directed enzyme prodrug system (MSC expressing cytosine deaminase); its antitumour effect depends on the excluded cell/gene therapy, so it may not count as a pharmacological candidate.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients scheduled to undergo surgical treatment for recurrent glioblastoma

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Blood concentrations of 5-FC and 5-FU(Day 1, Day 3, Day 7)

agents.active_moiety: cytosine deaminase gene-modified mesenchymal stem cell therapy

role_evidence.quote: MSC11FCD (other names: Mesenchymal stem cells into which the suicide gene, cytosine deaminase (CD))

agents.drug_class_hint: gene-modified mesenchymal stem cells expressing cytosine deaminase (suicide gene therapy)
arms: The investigational drug into the Intratumoral administration

role_evidence.quote: Administer 150m of 5-Flucytosine per kilogram of body weight every 6 hours for a total of 4 times a day (QID) for a duration of 7 days after surgery.

agents.drug_class_hint: antifungal; prodrug converted to 5-fluorouracil by cytosine deaminase

flag.reason: Prodrug component of a gene-directed enzyme prodrug therapy; candidate status depends on whether it is treated as part of the excluded gene/cell therapy.

arms: The investigational drug into the Intratumoral administration

coder_notes: Suicide gene therapy: MSCs transduced with cytosine deaminase injected intratumorally, followed by oral 5-flucytosine (registered as concomitant drug in the intervention description). MSC11FCD coded excluded_intervention_type (cell/gene therapy). Flucytosine coded as candidate with uncertainty; if adjudicated as part of the excluded therapy, S6 reason would be excluded_intervention_type. PK is blood only (5-FC, 5-FU) so tumour_pk_planned no. DPD deficiency exclusion is a germline safety marker, not recorded.
